get_cloudwatch_logs: fetch CloudWatch logs from a given log group and log stream in AWS
upload_file_to_s3: upload a local file to an S3 bucket folder with progress tracking and retries
create_s3_folder: create a new folder inside an S3 bucket if it does not already exist
get_s3_folder_contents: list the contents of a folder in an S3 bucket with pagination support
get_athena_query_execution_details: retrieve Athena query execution details by its execution ID from AWS
